tests.title: WS1 · Multi-currency — per-currency commission liability
steps: Open Finance → Commissions → Liability tab
Liability is tracked & totalled per currency so multi-country tenants aren't co-mingled
Branch revenue renders in the branch's own currency (MY vs TH package prices seen in the POS tour)
Approved/Paid/Net-Payable per staff, with branch + category + role filters and Export CSV

screenshots.caption: Commission Liability tab — Approved(unpaid)/Paid/Net-Payable, per-staff liability, branch+category+role filters, Export CSV (no activity in this window)

tests.title: WS2 · Operational reports suite (10 reports)
steps: Open Reports
Overview: revenue / active-members / churn / LTV / class-fill KPIs + 30-day revenue trend
Ten report tabs — Sales, Collections, Outstanding, Expiring Credits, Coach Productivity, Refunds & Cancellations, Sales Mix, Appointments, Redemptions, Services Owed
Every report: branch scope, tax-basis toggle, PDF/CSV export + scheduled email

screenshots.caption: Reports Overview — KPI cards (126 active members real data), Revenue Trend chart, all 10 report tabs, PDF/CSV/Schedule-Email
Sales report — row-level table, Incl-tax / Pre-tax basis toggle, Export CSV (no sales in this window on the test tenant)

tests.title: WS3 · Per-branch tax + company profile + gapless numbering
steps: Open Finance → Tax Rates
Rates scoped by COUNTRY (Malaysia SST 8%) or Org-wide (No-Tax 0% default)
Effective-from / effective-to dating + default flag per rate
Per-branch company profile + gapless SO/INV/PAY numbering — proven live in the POS tour (-000006)

screenshots.caption: Tax Rates — Malaysia SST 8% (country-scoped) + No-Tax 0% (org-wide default); COUNTRY column, effective dates, default flag

tests.title: WS4 · Appointment lifecycle automation
steps: Open Appointments
Trainer roster (102 trainers) + today's bookings on the schedule
Bulk status actions (updateStatusBulk) applied to selected appointments from the list
Hourly cron auto-completes past-due appointments (system actor)

screenshots.caption: Appointments schedule — 102-trainer roster + today's bookings; WS4 adds bulk status actions + the hourly auto-complete cron

tests.title: WS5 · Month-based payroll period lock
steps: Open Finance → Payroll Periods
Pick a branch + reference date, then Lock current period
A locked window freezes that commission month — write-gate blocks void / dispute / cancel inside it
State / Locked-at / Locked-by / Lock-kind tracked per branch

screenshots.caption: Payroll Periods — per-branch period lock; a real LOCKED row (MOVE BUKIT JALIL, Jun period, system-locked) with state/locked-at/lock-kind

tests.title: WS6 · Self-service CSV import
steps: Open Settings → Import Data
Choose what to import — Clients / Packages / Payments / Opening balances (loyalty credit)
Upload a CSV file or paste CSV
Preview validates every row before anything is written, then Commit; recent-imports history kept

screenshots.caption: Import Data — 4 import types, CSV upload/paste, Preview (validate-before-write) → Commit import, with import history

tests.title: WS7 · Self-service CSV export
steps: Open Settings → Export Data
Exports respect current branch scope (RBAC — you only get branches you can access)
14 individual datasets, each Download CSV
Full backup → single ZIP bundling every dataset

screenshots.caption: Export Data — branch-scoped; Export-all ZIP + 14 datasets incl 'Installments — installment amount, not full package price'
